exact_theorem.congruence: Positive geometry makes the finite weighted symmetric congruence well-defined.
exact_theorem.envelopes: For finite real T, ||T||_2 <= max row absolute sum and ||T||_2 <= ||T||_F.
exact_theorem.geometry: The weighted geometry is a finite sum of nonnegative rational squares.
exact_theorem.origin_protocol: The three origins are fixed deterministic grid points declared before replay and use no response or geometry score.
exact_theorem.replication_scope: The second-family replication is restricted to counts 512 and 1024, Q in {512,2048,8192}, exponent one, and the three declared origins.

origin_protocol.selection_rule: predeclared equally spaced grid points; no geometry ranking
